purpose: Phase-5B.1 SIGNALING EVIDENCE registry. Two parts: (1) reference records - symbolic keys used by nodes/edges, each with a verification_status; (2) an evidence audit trail recording HOW each evidence classification was assigned. ARCHITECTURE + EVIDENCE ONLY. No DOI is fabricated: canonical-biology keys point to established general relationships with NO specific citation asserted here, and celastrol/context claims are marked UNVERIFIED_IN_REPO pending primary-source attachment in Phase 5B.2.

chen_2012.citation: Chen Y et al. Int J Nanomedicine 2012;7:3023-3033 (DOI 10.2147/IJN.S32476)
chen_2012.note: The frozen Profile-B package's primary source. It anchors CONTEXT (species/cell/drug/formulation and the exposure start) but reports NO signaling cascade.

audit_trail.rationale: Chen measured celastrol-NLC uptake in HaCaT; exposure itself is drug/cell-specific experimental, downstream is not.
ROS elevation by celastrol in HaCaT not in frozen package; literature-derived prediction.
ROS->ERK is canonical general biology, not this context.
Nrf2->ARE regulatory state canonical; STOP before transcription.
ARE->HO-1 output state is a context/drug prediction; expression not modelled.
Celastrol NF-κB suppression in HaCaT not in frozen package.
Inhibitory entry edge is a context/drug prediction.
Celastrol PI3K suppression in B16BL6 not in frozen package.
Inhibitory entry edge is a context/drug prediction.
mTOR->survival output canonical; STOP before apoptosis.

integrity_rules.no_fabricated_dois: Canonical relationships carry NO fabricated DOI; celastrol/context claims are UNVERIFIED_IN_REPO until a primary source is attached and verified.
integrity_rules.frozen_package_boundary: Only chen_2012 is VERIFIED_IN_FROZEN_PACKAGE, and it supports CONTEXT (uptake) only, never a signaling node/edge.
integrity_rules.not_reported_stays_not_reported: Where the frozen package reports nothing (all signaling), evidence is a labelled prediction or NOT_REPORTED - never upgraded to experimental.
